name: dsh-usage-cost
description: 在 DSH 自带「用量」弹窗里，把每个 token 环节折算成金额显示在 token 数字右边（DeepSeek 官方价目表 + 峰谷价，口径与小鲸鱼挂件 dsh-whale-widget 同源）

scripts.test: node tools/probe-syntax.mjs && node tools/probe-pricing.mjs && node tools/probe-decorate.mjs

summary.en: Shows the CNY cost of each token bucket next to the token counts in DSH's built-in usage dialogs, priced by the turn's own peak/off-peak time.
summary.zh: 在 DSH 自带「用量」弹窗里，把每个 token 环节折算成金额标在 token 数字右边，并按这一轮自己的峰谷时段定价。

author: O789Real
